 Africa Cup of Nations Qualification
 How and Where to Watch: Mozambique vs Ethiopia LIVE on beIN SPORTS
 Mozambique and Ethiopia meet in a crucial 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifier, with the Mambas looking to extend their unbeaten start in Group J. Ethiopia, meanwhile, is searching for its first points after two narrow defeats.
 Watch Mozambique vs Ethiopia LIVE on beIN SPORTS 
 Mozambique vs Ethiopia: How and Where to Watch LIVE 
 Mozambique will host Ethiopia on Friday, November 13, for Matchday 3 of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifiers .
 The encounter will take place at Estádio Nacional do Zimpeto in Maputo, Mozambique, with kickoff scheduled for 8:00 AM ET / 5:00 AM PT .
 Fans can follow the match through beIN SPORTS CONNECT , with the English-language event listing showing coverage beginning at 7:50 AM ET .
 Mozambique enters the encounter with four points from two matches, level with Senegal, while Ethiopia remains at the bottom of Group J without a point.
 How Mozambique Comes Into the Match 
 Mozambique enters Friday's match looking to build on an impressive start to its qualifying campaign.
 The team coached by Chiquinho Conde opened Group J with a 1-1 draw against Senegal on September 25.
 Nicolas Jackson gave Senegal the lead in the 32nd minute, but Geny Catamo equalized shortly after halftime to secure an important point for the Mambas.
 Four days later, Mozambique recorded a convincing 4-1 victory over Sudan at Estádio Nacional do Zimpeto.
 Witi opened the scoring in the first half, while Chamito Alfândega scored twice and Guima added another goal. Sudan's Yasin Hamed converted a late penalty.
 For the November double-header, Conde has named a 26-player squad, including Catamo , Bruno Langa , Edmilson Dove , and Stanley Ratifo .
 The selection also features first-time call-up Cremildo Mussanganhe , alongside returning players Diogo Cabral and Keyns Abdala .
 How Ethiopia Comes Into the Match 
 Ethiopia travels to Maputo looking to recover after losing its opening two qualifiers.
 The Walia Ibex began their campaign with a 1-0 defeat against Sudan on September 25.
 Mohamed Eisa converted a penalty in the 86th minute to secure victory for the Sudanese side.
 Four days later, Ethiopia suffered another 1-0 defeat against Senegal .
 Ibrahim Mbaye scored the only goal in the 11th minute, leaving Ethiopia without points despite conceding just twice across its opening two matches.
 Head coach Yohannes Sahilu has made significant changes to the squad for the upcoming encounters.
 His 23-player selection includes goalkeeper Abubeker Nura , midfielder Gatoch Panom , and forward Kenean Markneh .
 Ethiopia will attempt to turn its competitive performances into points against a Mozambique side enjoying strong early momentum.
 Mozambique vs Ethiopia: Important Points at Stake in Group J 
 Group J remains tightly contested after the opening two rounds.
 Senegal and Mozambique have four points each, followed by Sudan with three. Ethiopia remains fourth without a point.
 The top two teams will qualify for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations , hosted by Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda .
 The nations will meet again on Tuesday, November 17 , at Bahir Dar International Stadium in Ethiopia.
 For Mozambique, the double-header offers an opportunity to strengthen its qualification position. Ethiopia, meanwhile, needs a positive result to reduce the gap to its rivals.
